primary.title: Form 141 for TDS: What taxpayers need to know about the new challan-cum-statement under the Income Tax Act 2025
primary.summary: Form 141 is the new unified challan-cum-statement for specified TDS transactions under the Income Tax Act 2025. Know who needs to file it, which transactions it covers, the applicable deadlines, and how to submit the form.
